title: Act: Add frame CSS classes, Frame component, framed Button and wire them into the game screen
summary: frameKit plugin, Frame, Button frame variant, wiring
description: Generate .sf-frame-* and .sf-btn classes from FRAME_KIT, add components and apply them in the screen.
acceptance_criteria: Frame classes use border-image and image-rendering pixelated
Button frame variant exposes four states
Header, aside, dialogue, inventory and trigger use the kit
definition_of_done: Game screen elements carry frame classes

steps.action: Import FRAME_KIT from ../art/uiFrames. Export frameComponentClasses(): Record<string,Record<string,string>> that for bar, panel, plaque, parchment and slot returns '.sf-frame-<name>' with borderStyle 'solid', borderWidth '<slice>px', borderImage `url(/assets/ui/frames/<file>.png) <slice> fill / <slice>px stretch`, imageRendering 'pixelated'; for buttons returns '.sf-btn' (normal frame), '.sf-btn:hover:not(:disabled)' and ".sf-btn[data-state='hover']" (hover frame), '.sf-btn:active:not(:disabled)' and ".sf-btn[data-state='pressed']" (pressed), '.sf-btn:disabled' and ".sf-btn[data-state='disabled']" (disabled), and '.sf-cursor' with cursor url(/assets/ui/cursors/hand.png) 4 0, pointer.
steps.expected: Returned object has a .sf-frame-panel key with imageRendering pixelated

steps.action: Add a second plugin call: plugin(({ addComponents }) => addComponents(frameComponentClasses())), importing frameComponentClasses from './src/lib/frameKit'.

Export type FrameKind = 'bar'|'panel'|'plaque'|'parchment'|'slot' and component Frame({kind, as:Tag='div', className, ...props}) rendering <Tag className={cn(`sf-frame-${kind}`, className)} data-frame={kind} {...props} /> using cn from ../../lib/utils.

Extend ButtonVariant with 'frame'. Add variantClasses.frame = 'sf-btn inline-flex items-center gap-2 font-pixel text-sf-sm'. Add optional prop state?: 'normal'|'hover'|'pressed'|'disabled' to ButtonProps; destructure it and, when variant is 'frame', pass data-state={state} and disabled={props.disabled || state==='disabled'} to the element. Do not change default or ghost classes.
steps.expected: <Button variant='frame' state='pressed'> has class sf-btn and data-state='pressed'

steps.action: Add class 'sf-frame-bar' to the <header> className and set variant="frame" on the Retry, Toggle sound and Settings Buttons (keep aria-label, aria-pressed and handlers).
steps.expected: header has sf-frame-bar; the three buttons have sf-btn

steps.action: Append 'sf-frame-panel' to the motion.aside className and set variant="frame" on the Story toggle Button (keep aria-expanded and onClick).
steps.expected: aside has sf-frame-panel and toggle has sf-btn

steps.action: Add class 'sf-frame-parchment' to the <section aria-label="Dialogue"> and class 'sf-frame-slot' to each inventory <li>. Keep aria-labels and text.
steps.expected: Dialogue section has sf-frame-parchment; inventory items have sf-frame-slot

steps.symbol: Suggest What Happens Next trigger Button
steps.action: Set variant="frame" on the Button whose text is 'Suggest What Happens Next', keeping ref=triggerRef and its onClick.
